data.title: 牧之原翔子 · 毕业季的樱花坡道
data.description: 春日坡道，她穿着制服站在纷飞的樱花里，双手背在身后微微前倾；不是告别式的伤感，而是带着神秘微笑的「后会有期」，风把花瓣吹过她的肩线。
data.action: 春日坡道，她穿着制服站在纷飞的樱花里，双手背在身后微微前倾
data.promptProse: Shouko leans slightly forward on the spring hillside path, hands loosely clasped behind her back, offering a quietly reassuring blue-eyed smile. Cherry petals pass her sailor collar and dark hair in the medium view. The slope continues behind her between flowering trees, their branches overlapping the pale sky. Soft afternoon light reaches her face through the blossoms, with gentle shadows on the uniform folds beneath her bent shoulders.
